input.summary:
Wing kitchen and scullery furnished in parts/room-3.mjs: brick range with lit furnace and smoker on the south wall (x7..8 z29) in line with the lobby door, a worktable with two stair chairs, pantry barrels on the west wall, scullery sink and worktop under the kitchen window, and seven lanterns (six hanging from the y13 floor, one standing) for 0 dark cells.
The room check says OK: 42 of 42 floor cells reachable, light min 8, mean 10.5, no dark or dim cells. make.sh produced a whole build.nbt with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes for this part; door cells x6 z23 and x10 z27 are kept clear.
Rendered the room sheet (room.png); the from-above view reads, but the inside view does not show the range, so the focal piece is not yet confirmed from inside.
left: Ownership conflict with hearth.mjs: the wing range at x7..8 z29 is listed in elements.md item 14 (hearth part), but this room part also builds it; whichever part runs first wins and the other's writes are refused. I added a Notes line in plan.md; the hearth worker should leave those cells to room-3 or the two should be reconciled.
The inside render does not clearly show the range at the south wall; the focal piece should be checked from the lobby door once the shell and hearth are merged.
room-3 is not a checklist item in plan.md and no elements.md item maps to it, so nothing was ticked.

waste.what: Mapped the plan grid's characters to world coordinates by hand (x = 4 + column index, z = 22 + row index) and wrote out each furniture row as a text string.
waste.cost: about 7 rows x 6 columns per layer, two layers, plus one correction pass after the first draft; no separate retries of blocks.
waste.tool: A `mcd plan --emit-legend` or `layers` variant that takes the plan grid itself with a per-character legend and returns the placed set, so the furnisher copies only the furniture characters rather than re-deriving origin offsets.

waste.what: Tried light positions by guessing lantern spots, then rebuilt twice to reach 0 dim cells.
waste.cost: three make.sh runs and two room checks; the tool's own suggestion (a standing lantern at 5,6,27) appeared only on the second pass.
waste.tool: `mcd room --apply` or a lamp-placement mode that writes the suggested lantern spots into the part, so the lamplighter does not iterate by hand.

waste.what: Checked for a shared-range conflict with the hearth part by reading plan.md, not by query.
waste.cost: one read of elements.md and plan.md; the conflict only shows at merge time.
waste.tool: A `runParts` pre-check that lists which cells two parts both claim (a reserved-cell manifest per part) before the parallel build.

companions.task: Agree who builds the wing range at x7..8 z29 and its flue cells, so the furnace and smoker are placed once and the lit range reads as the room's focal piece from the lobby door.
Check the lantern spots against the final shell's ceiling so the six hanging lanterns hang from real y13 floor blocks, and confirm the standing pantry lantern at 5,6,27 once the floor is merged.
